name: Food Agent
description: Finds restaurants and dining options. Searches near current position or a specified location and optionally filters results by cuisine or food type.

skills.name: Find Restaurants and Dining Options
skills.description: Finds nearby restaurants, cafes, and dining options around current position or a specified city, address, or landmark. Supports cuisine or food filters such as pizza, sushi, Chinese, vegan, and fast food.
examples: what are the closest American restaurants?
find some good sushi in Berlin
